'''Shajahm-Do''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] living during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Shajahm served under the great mystic [[Dokath-Ra]] and at one point his master ordered him to found and conducted to him a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] that was on Voss. Shajahm executed the order but unfortunately the Hunter killed him and Dokath.
